arxiv-1709-08491.title: Statistical learning of spatiotemporal patterns from longitudinal manifold-valued networks
arxiv-1709-08491.creator: I. Koval, J.-B. Schiratti, A. Routier, M. Bacci, O. Colliot, S. Allassonnière, S. Durrleman, the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
arxiv-1709-08491.description: Abstract We introduce a mixed-effects model to learn spatiotemporal patterns on a network by considering longitudinal measures distributed on a fixed graph. The data come from repeated observations of subjects at different time points which take the form of measurement maps distributed on a graph such as an image or a mesh.

arxiv-2003-05669.title: ARAE: Adversarially Robust Training of Autoencoders Improves Novelty Detection
arxiv-2003-05669.creator: Mohammadreza Salehi, Atrin Arya, Barbod Pajoum, Mohammad Otoofi, Amirreza Shaeiri, Mohammad Hossein Rohban, Hamid R. Rabiee
arxiv-2003-05669.description: Abstract ae ( ae ) have recently been widely employed to approach the novelty detection problem. Trained only on the normal data, the AE is expected to reconstruct the normal data effectively while failing to regenerate the anomalous data. Based on this assumption, one could utilize the AE for novelty detection.

arxiv-2009-04909.title: Disjunctive Delimited Control This article is an extended version of the paper with the same name that first appeared in the LOPSTR 2021 post-proceedings edited by Emanuele De Angelis and Wim Vanhoof.
arxiv-2009-04909.creator: ALEXANDER VANDENBROUCKE, TOM SCHRIJVERS
arxiv-2009-04909.description: Abstract Delimited control is a powerful mechanism for programming language extension which has been recently proposed for Prolog (and implemented in SWI-Prolog). By manipulating the control flow of a program from inside the language, it enables the implementation of powerful features, such as tabling, without modifying the internals of the Prolog engine.

arxiv-2209-14119.title: A new proof of the Pythagorean Theorem and generalization of the usual algebra norm
arxiv-2209-14119.creator: Fred Greensite
arxiv-2209-14119.description: Abstract . A new proof of the Pythagorean Theorem is presented, utilizing George Birkhoff’s version of the postulates of Euclidean geometry as incorporating ℝ \mathbb{R} . Extrapolation of the mechanism of proof leads to a generalization of the usual algebra norm associated with a real finite-dimensional unital associative algebra, and resulting novel computationally accessible algebra isomorphism invariants.

arxiv-2210-15907.description: Abstract Credit-based congestion pricing (CBCP) has emerged as a mechanism to alleviate the social inequity concerns of road congestion pricing - a promising strategy for traffic congestion mitigation - by providing low-income users with travel credits to offset some of their toll payments.

arxiv-2307-13557.title: A unified class of null proportion estimators with plug-in FDR control
arxiv-2307-13557.creator: Sebastian Döhler, Iqraa Meah
arxiv-2307-13557.description: Abstract Since the work of Storey et al., 2004 , it is well-known that the performance of the Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure can be improved by incorporating estimators of the number (or proportion) of null hypotheses, yielding an adaptive BH procedure which still controls FDR.

arxiv-2310-14691.title: Identifiability of total effects from abstractions of time series causal graphs
arxiv-2310-14691.creator: Charles K. Assaad, Emilie Devijver, Eric Gaussier, Gregor Gössler, Anouar Meynaoui
arxiv-2310-14691.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Charles K. Assaad, Emilie Devijver, Eric Gaussier, Gregor Gössler, Anouar Meynaoui. pmc-10755415.title: Intake of ultra-processed food, dietary diversity and the risk of nutritional inadequacy among adults in India
pmc-10755415.creator: Srishti Mediratta, Santu Ghosh, Pulkit Mathur
pmc-10755415.description: Objective:This study assessed diet diversity and consumption of ultra-processed foods and explored its impact on macronutrient intake and risk of micronutrient inadequacy.Design:Cross-sectional, non-probability snowball sampling.Setting:Nutrient intake was assessed using 24-h dietary recall method and diet diversity through FAO-diet diversity score (DDS). pmc-12615726.title: Protocol for analyzing shoot apical meristem development and heat stress responses in tomato
pmc-12615726.creator: Nan Xiao, Cao Xu, Xiaozhen Huang
pmc-12615726.description: SummaryShoot apical meristem (SAM) development is critical for plant aerial architecture and reproduction, but its spatiotemporal specificity and phenotyping challenges hinder mechanistic studies, particularly under stresses. Here, we present a protocol for molecular and cellular analysis of SAM development and stress response in tomato. We describe steps for imaging, developmental stage-specific heat treatment, and recovery growth.

pmc-13249689.title: “The Computer as a Sophisticated Disguise of the Devil”
pmc-13249689.creator: Johann Meyer
pmc-13249689.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Christian churches are sometimes perceived as being hostile towards technology due to the supposed incompatibility of the cold, rational world of technology and the warm, humane organization of the church. Even when electronic data processing (EDP) was introduced in German-speaking Protestant churches in Western Europe, a lack of acceptance of technology was repeatedly problematized by church digitization pioneers as a central hurdle in church digitization processes.
